response.output_text: {"score":3,"evidence":"We outsource the manufacturing of our products to various manufacturing partners, which include our electronics manufacturing services provider (“EMS provider”) and original design manufacturers. This approach allows us to reduce our costs as it reduces our manufacturing overhead and inventory and also allows us to adjust more quickly to changing end-customer demand. Our EMS provider is Flextronics International, Ltd. (“Flex”), who assembles our products using design specifications, quality assurance programs, and standards that we establish, and procures components and assembles our products based on our demand forecasts.","rationale":"The filing states that Palo Alto Networks outsources manufacturing to partners including Flextronics, who procure components and assemble products based on demand forecasts. This indicates substantial reliance on overseas manufacturing and imported components, which could materially affect costs or operations. The mention of procurement of components implies dependence on foreign-made inputs. However, the filing does not state that imports or overseas manufacturing are central to the business or that most products depend on these arrangements, so score 4 is not supported."}
